trip.trip_notes: Budget wise, I want my trip to be A mix of both luxury and budget friendly ; I am solo traveling ; My trip should include a mix of these: Local's favorite resturants or spots, or things to do that involves local culture , Museums, art, and history, Nightlife & bars ; Specifically, I have these requirements: I love pastries, would want to buy some souvenir

plans.trip_plan: Enjoy pastries and coffee at a classic Madrid café.
plans.plan_location: La Mallorquina, Puerta del Sol, Madrid
plans.plan_details: Walk from your accommodation or take Metro to Sol station.

plans.trip_plan: Explore masterpieces at the Prado Museum focusing on Velázquez and Goya.
plans.plan_location: Museo Nacional del Prado, Paseo del Prado, Madrid
plans.plan_details: Walk or take Metro to Banco de España and follow signs to the museum.

plans.trip_plan: Have a traditional Spanish lunch with a mix of locals and visitors.
plans.plan_location: Taberna El Sur, Barrio de Las Letras, Madrid
plans.plan_details: Walk through the Retiro or Paseo del Prado area to Barrio de Las Letras.

plans.trip_plan: Stroll Retiro Park and visit the Crystal Palace, then browse souvenir shops in nearby streets.
plans.plan_location: Parque de El Retiro and Palacio de Cristal, Madrid
plans.plan_details: Walk from Barrio de Las Letras toward Retiro Park entrances.

plans.trip_plan: Enjoy tapas, drinks, and nightlife around La Latina’s Cava Baja and Plaza de la Cebada.
plans.plan_details: Take Metro to La Latina or walk from the center, then bar-hop on foot.

plans.trip_plan: Try artisanal pastries and specialty coffee at a modern bakery.
plans.plan_details: Take Metro or walk to Lavapiés from your accommodation.

plans.trip_plan: Discover Spanish art and Picasso’s Guernica at the Reina Sofía Museum.
plans.plan_location: Museo Nacional Centro de Arte Reina Sofía, Atocha, Madrid
plans.plan_details: Walk or take Metro/Cercanías to Atocha and follow museum signs.
plans.place_display_name: Museo Nacional Centro de Arte Reina Sofía

plans.trip_plan: Browse food stalls, buy gourmet souvenir products, and have a casual lunch.
plans.plan_location: Mercado de San Miguel, Plaza Mayor area, Madrid
plans.plan_details: Walk from Reina Sofía via central streets or take Metro to Sol/Ópera.

plans.trip_plan: Visit the Royal Palace and Almudena Cathedral, then wander the historic center.
plans.plan_location: Palacio Real de Madrid and Catedral de la Almudena, Madrid
plans.plan_details: Walk through Plaza Mayor area to the Royal Palace complex.
plans.place_display_name: Catedral de Santa María la Real de la Almudena

plans.trip_plan: Experience an evening flamenco show with drinks or dinner nearby for a cultural night out.
plans.plan_location: Corral de la Morería, near Palacio Real, Madrid
plans.plan_details: Walk back toward the palace area or take a short taxi ride from the center.
